title: CarPi5 In-Dash Infotainment & Companion Operating Guide

factual_data.status_bar_layout: Top Status Bar: From left to right: Centered cabin/outdoor temperature badge, gear shift & coast indicator (flashes ⟲ shifting or shows ≋ coasting when clutch is in / in neutral at speed), Home button, on-screen keyboard toggle button, Wi-Fi status button (touch for connection strength and IP stats popup), Bluetooth button (touch for device pairing popup), and live system clock (HH:MM AM/PM sync with Pi RTC and NTP).
factual_data.touch_room_customizer: 3D Room Customizer: Accessed in R.U.M. Room mode via the 🛋️ CUSTOMIZE ROOM button. Allows placing any .OBJ, .GLTF, or .GLB 3D models stored in /storage/models/props/ or on plugged-in USB drives. Controls include 4-way floor D-Pad (Up/Down/Left/Right), Elevation (Raise, Lower, Snap to Floor), Rotation (±20°), Scale (±15%), Call R.U.M. to Prop, and Remove Prop. Layouts persist to config/custom_room_layout.json.
factual_data.camera_tracking_modes: R.U.M. Camera Controls: ROOM (panoramic view of the entire room), FULL BODY (centers full body and follows walking roam), BUST / PORTRAIT (chest-up focus following movement), and AUTOZOOM (automatically frames bust/face when R.U.M. speaks or interacts, then pulls back to body view when idle).
factual_data.in_dash_library: In-Dash Library: Accessed via the 📚 Library card on the Home screen. Contains 3 full books: 1. CarPi5 System Architecture & Operations Manual, 2. 2013 Dodge Dart OEM Owner's Manual (610-page searchable document), 3. Dodge Dart Service & Repair Guide. Includes page flip controls, jump-to-chapter, and full in-dash PDF viewing.
factual_data.media_hub: Media & Entertainment: Dedicated cards for Audio Studio (local FLAC/MP3 player with responsive spectrum visualizer), YouTube Cinema & YouTube Music (fullscreen touch streaming), and Stremio Cinema (ARM64 native streaming with Torrentio, AnimeStream, and ThePirateBay+ add-ons).

guidelines: When the driver asks about CarPi5 controls, room customization, status bar buttons, or entertainment cards, cite these exact instructions.
